name: Calhoun County Family Resource Network & Family Support Center
description: Family support, food pantry, hygiene and baby supplies, parenting classes, job readiness, WRAP planning and SMART Recovery meetings. Some supplies have household eligibility restrictions.
access: Call or visit; food pantry walk-ins welcomed during posted hours. Call ahead for classes and availability.

name: Calhoun County Department of Human Services
description: Local office for applications and case assistance involving SNAP, Medicaid, WV WORKS, energy and other eligible family assistance programs.
access: Call the county office or apply online using WV PATH; eligibility determined by the agency.

name: Westbrook Health Services
description: Behavioral health, counseling, youth services and substance use treatment serving Calhoun and neighboring counties. Ask about telehealth and available appointments.
address: Main office: 2121 Seventh Street, Parkersburg, WV 26101; Roane office: 227 Clay Road, Spencer, WV 25276
access: Call intake to discuss services, location, payment and appointment availability.
hours: See current hours on provider website

name: Westbrook 24/7 Crisis Services
description: 24/7 call/text crisis support and mobile crisis services in Westbrook's service area, including Calhoun County.
access: Call or text 304-485-1725; alternate phone 800-579-5844. For immediate physical danger call 911.

name: HELP4WV
description: Statewide 24/7 confidential help locating mental health and substance use treatment, including referrals and recovery support.
address: Phone, text and online service statewide
access: Call or text 844-435-7498 or use the website chat.

name: West Virginia 211
description: Free statewide information and referral assistance for food, shelter, utility, transportation and other community needs.
access: Dial 211, call 833-848-9905, or text your ZIP code to 898-211.

name: WV PATH Benefits Portal
description: Online applications for SNAP, Medicaid/WVCHIP, childcare assistance, home energy assistance and other state programs.
access: Screen for assistance and apply online; county office can help with applications.
hours: Online portal; phone assistance hours vary

name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
description: Free confidential crisis support for people experiencing emotional distress or suicidal thoughts.
access: Call or text 988; call 911 for immediate danger or medical emergency.
